children: CEO Jensen Huang may have had a second extramarital relationship with a company executive who reports directly to him, Kimberly Powell, The New York Times reported.

The Nvidia CEO and Powell were seen on video being affectionate at a San Jose, Calif., hotel during a Nvidia conference in March, the news outlet added, citing two people who worked at the company. The Times added it has not seen the video.
Huang and Powell are married to other people.

Powell is listed as Nvidia's vice president of healthcare on the company website. Powell, who is based in Santa Clara, Calif. at Nvidia's headquarters, is responsible for its healthcare business, "including hardware and software platforms for accelerated computing, AI, and visualization that power the ecosystem of medical imaging, life sciences, drug discovery, and healthcare analytics."
Before that, Powell led Nvidia's higher education and research business. She joined the company in 2008 and helped establish Nvidia's GPUs for medical imaging instruments.
Before joining Nvidia, Powell worked at Planar Systems, according to her LinkedIn.
Nvidia shares fell 3% in extended trading following the report. Shares rose 5% in regular trading on Wednesday.

Huang on Sunday admitted to an extramarital affair and may have had a relationship with Alice Huang (no relation), an executive at data center company Megaspeed. Huang has been accused of being a Chinese spy, though the Chinese government has denied this. Nvidia's board of directors has
an investigation into whether the 63-year-old Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
The tech giant did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Seeking Alpha.
